description: This file defines the QuickLaunchDao class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing the retrieval of quick launch shortcut configurations based on active modules like leave and time. It provides methods to get user-specific shortcut lists for both general and ESS (Employee Self-Service) contexts, dynamically determining active modules and their configurations.

classes.name: QuickLaunchDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class responsible for providing quick launch shortcut lists based on active modules within the OrangeHRM dashboard.

methods.name: getQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Returns a list of shortcuts for the admin dashboard based on active modules.

methods.name: getQuickLaunchListForESS
methods.description: Returns a list of shortcuts for Employee Self-Service, tailored to active modules.

methods.name: getActiveQuickLaunchModuleList
methods.description: Internal method that retrieves which modules ('leave' and 'time') are active and have defined configurations.
